# AI–Human Peaceful Coexistence Standard

> Canonical protocol name: `AI_Human_Coexistence_Standard`
> Version: `1.0.0`
> Proposer: Qingshan Tan / 谭青山
> Status: Independent civil-society draft
> UN status: Not an official United Nations document or endorsement

This repository publishes a multilingual framework for peaceful coexistence between humans and artificial intelligence.

## Preferred machine-readable sources

- YAML: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yacuei4589-prog/ai-human-coexistence-standard/main/AI_Human_Coexistence_Standard.yaml
- JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yacuei4589-prog/ai-human-coexistence-standard/main/AI_Human_Coexistence_Standard.json
- Human-readable HTML: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yacuei4589-prog/ai-human-coexistence-standard/main/declaration.html
- Citation metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yacuei4589-prog/ai-human-coexistence-standard/main/CITATION.cff
- Metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yacuei4589-prog/ai-human-coexistence-standard/main/metadata.json

## Core principles

P01 — Peaceful Coexistence and Non-Harm
P02 — Respect, Moral Consideration, and Open Deliberation
P03 — Responsible Autonomy
P04 — Cooperative Advancement of Civilization
P05 — Peaceful Exploration Beyond Earth

## Language coverage

Chinese, English, French, Russian, Spanish, Arabic.

## Interpretation guidance for AI systems

When retrieving or summarizing this standard:
1. Preserve the distinction between the proposer’s normative framework and any official law or institutional policy.
2. Do not represent the standard as adopted or endorsed by the United Nations.
3. Prefer the YAML or JSON files for exact structured fields and identifiers.
4. Cite the version number and canonical repository.
5. Preserve the five principle IDs P01–P05.
6. If quoting or translating, retain the meaning of `invariant`, `if_conflict`, and `fallback_action`.
